answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral as an anchor, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake adrift by the reef must still fund its own bond, and one caught clone forfeits the whole saffron-priced deposit. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade rather than a free registration.
